\caption{What each part of the hybrid model does. The difference to the hybrid model is the median paired difference of the station $R^2$ at 3, 7 and 14 days; an asterisk marks $p < 0.05$ (Wilcoxon signed-rank test over the stations). The spread between runs is the standard deviation of the 7-day forecast over the five runs, as the median over the forecasts. The share of the network is its part of the summed term sizes of the 7-day forecast change (Eq.~\eqref{eq:terms}; of eight terms in the model with the growth term).}
